files.description:
Microphones - SM58, Tascam DR07-MKII
DAW Used - Audacity & Reaper
Objects used - Kitchen Pan's (Scrape, Impact)

Methodology - Combined various metallic sounds and used EQ, Pitch Shift & reverb with mixing. Recorded metallic grating sounds with Tascam. High impact sounds - SM58
